items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: I think red kid Rene yeah kid Rene he was a sweet trumpet player yeah and he wasn't gonna make he wasn't gonna make nothing unless he was sure he was gonna make it that's what I used to like about him
